mapper.select: SELECT pm.process_instance_id, max(pm.process_definition_id) as process_definition_id, max(pm.process_version) as process_version, max(pm.process_status) as process_status, max(pm.process_name) as process_name, max(pm.business_id) as business_id, max(pm.business_code) as business_code, max(pm.business_name) as business_name, max(pm.start_time) as start_time, max(pm.end_time) as end_time, max(pm.act_process_definition_id) as act_process_definition_id, string_agg(ptm.cur_approve_name, ', ') AS cur_approve_name, max(wm.detail_url) as detail_url FROM process_management AS pm LEFT JOIN process_task_management AS ptm on pm.process_instance_id = ptm.process_instance_id LEFT JOIN work_menu AS wm on pm.business_key = wm.module_code where ptm.task_status = 'approveIng' GROUP BY pm.process_instance_id order by pm.create_time desc
